scope: Mass spectrometry analyses of Tau filaments extracted from PrP-CAA (Q160X) and GSS (F198S) brains
Sarkosyl-insoluble Tau was extracted from gray matter of fresh-frozen frontal cortex

the sarkosyl-insoluble pellets were resuspended in 10 µl/g tissue 50 mM Tris–HCl, pH 7.4. This resuspended pellet was further purified by 30-fold dilution in A68 extraction buffer, followed by centrifugation at 20,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C. The pellet, containing large contaminants, was discarded, and the supernatant was centrifuged at 100,000 × g for 1 h at 4 °C. The final pellet was resuspended in 20 mM Tris–HCl, pH 7.4, and 100 mM NaCl
8 M urea, 50 mM Tris–HCl pH 8.5 (100 µl) was added to 20 µl of insoluble Tau fractions.
